SLS.headline: SELLAS Life Sciences Announces Positive Pivotal Phase 3 REGAL Trial Data Showing Immunotherapeutic Cancer Vaccine, Galinpepimut-S (GPS), Demonstrated a Statistically Significant and Clinically Meaningful Improvement in Overall Survival in Patients with Acute Myeloid Leukemia
SLS.description: SELLAS Life Sciences announced positive topline results from its Phase 3 REGAL trial of galinpepimut-S (GPS), an immunotherapeutic cancer vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia. GPS demonstrated a statistically significant 41% reduction in risk of death with median overall survival of 24.0 months versus 14.7 months for best available treatment (hazard ratio 0.59, p=0.035). The company plans to meet with the FDA and submit a Biologics License Application in the first half of 2027.
